metaDescription: Velvet Keys — Absolute Control. Rental-management and estate stewardship SaaS for Morocco covering short-term and long-term rentals.

hero.line3: Every stay. Every lease. One ledger.
hero.subcopy: One platform for owners and conciergeries across Morocco: Airbnb and Booking.com bookings, leases and rent, and every figure in dirhams with the commission on its own line.

c1.headline: See what you truly earn
c1.body: Gross revenue from short-term and long-term rentals, the manager's commission and the operating costs, all in dirhams. Net profit is the line at the bottom, never a guess.

c2.headline: Every night, priced and counted
c2.body: Airbnb and Booking.com reservations land on one calendar. Peak nights stand out, and each stay shows what it earns after commission.

c3.headline: Each property, short and long term
c3.body: Apartments let by the night, by the year, or both. Every property shows its split between short-term and long-term revenue, and the commission it generated.

marquee.title: Signature residences
marquee.subtitle: Six residences on one ledger: short stays, long leases, and every dirham of commission accounted for.

twoHorizons.label: Three ways to use Velvet Keys

owner.headline: See what you truly earn
owner.body: Your short-term and long-term revenue side by side, in dirhams, property by property. The commission is its own line, so net profit is never a guess.

features.title: One view of the whole portfolio
features.desc: Short-term and long-term revenue together, with the split for each property.

features.title: Commission shown, not buried
features.desc: Gross revenue, commission and costs add up to your net profit, line by line.

features.title: Statements for you and your accountant
features.desc: Monthly owner statements as PDF, ready to share.

conciergerie.headline: Run every owner from one desk
conciergerie.body: Bookings from every channel, repairs with proof, and the commission you earn on short stays and long leases, calculated for you.

features.title: One calendar for every stay
features.desc: Airbnb, Booking.com and owner blocks in one place, with no double bookings.

features.title: Repairs and expenses with proof
features.desc: Each cost is logged with a photo before it reaches an owner's statement.

features.title: Commission calculated for you
features.desc: Set a percentage per owner and per property; short-term and long-term are totalled separately.

ltr.headline: Leases and rent, under control
ltr.body: Every lease, every rent due date and every payment in one place, next to your short-term bookings and in the same dirhams.

features.title: Leases and renewals
features.desc: Contracts, rent amounts, deposits and end dates, with a reminder before a lease runs out.

features.title: Rent tracking
features.desc: See who has paid, who is due and who is late, month after month.

features.title: Receipts and owner statements
features.desc: Receipts for tenants and a monthly statement for owners, with your commission worked out.

ltr.endingAlert: A lease ends in {{days}} days · renewal reminder set

channels.title: Connected to Airbnb & Booking.com
channels.subtitle: Reservations, availability and rates move both ways, so your calendar is always the same everywhere and every booking arrives with its commission worked out.

events.rate: Nightly rate updated on both channels

twoWay.title: Two-way sync
twoWay.desc: Bookings come in and availability and rates go out, without anyone retyping a thing.

noDoubleBookings.title: No double bookings
noDoubleBookings.desc: A night booked on one platform closes on the other within moments.

commission.title: Commission included
commission.desc: Each booking arrives with its gross amount and the commission it earns.

howItWorks.title: Three steps to a clear ledger
howItWorks.subtitle: From the first property to the monthly statement, in a few minutes of setup and no spreadsheets.

step1.title: Add your properties
step1.body: Add each property as short-term, long-term or both, with its owner, its target revenue and the commission you take.

step2.title: Bookings and rent flow in
step2.body: Airbnb and Booking.com reservations sync into one calendar, rent is tracked lease by lease, and every expense is logged with a photo.

step3.title: Everyone sees the numbers
step3.body: Owners see gross revenue, commission and net profit in dirhams, and can download a PDF statement for their accountant at any time.

numbers.stat1Sub: Short-term and long-term rentals across Morocco
numbers.stat2Sub: Audited yields across high season and direct stays
numbers.stat3Sub: From an Airbnb or Booking.com change to your calendar
numbers.stat4Sub: Every figure reconciles, from gross revenue to net profit

manifesto.title: The Velvet Keys Manifesto
manifesto.quote: “True luxury in asset stewardship is not excess—it is absolute control, quiet discretion, and immutable arithmetic.”

bento.title: Engineered without compromise
bento.subtitle: Six foundations that keep operations calm and every figure verified.

heatmap.title: Occupancy and demand heatmap
heatmap.body: A multi-month calendar that shows high-season pressure, event peaks and nightly rates across your properties.

pdf.title: One-click PDF statements
pdf.body: Print-ready owner statements in Moroccan dirhams, with the short-term and long-term split and the commission line, for owners and their accountants.

calendar.title: Unified calendar
calendar.body: Bookings from every channel on one calendar, without collisions.

repairs.title: Photo-logged repairs
repairs.body: Every contractor payment is tied to photographic proof before it is approved.

switcher.title: Property switcher
switcher.body: Move between city apartments, coastal villas and riads in one click.

commission.title: Commission and net profit
commission.body: Set a commission per owner. Every statement shows gross revenue, the short-term and long-term split, the commission, the costs and the net profit, in dirhams.
commission.footer: STR and LTR on one statement

getStarted.sub: Create your account and choose how you will use it. You can set up your first property in a few minutes.
